races.title: Download The BetMGM App Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Preference is for DIXIE MAFIA , who improved on his hurdles form straight away with an emphatic success on chasing debut at Perth in April. He seems sure to do better in this sphere and can see off the challenge of the hat-trick seeking Off The Jury , while it would be no surprise to see Barnpark leave his chasing/stable debut effort behind up in trip. DIXIE MAFIA (IRE) OFF THE JURY (IRE) BARNPARK

races.verdict: ALL IN YOU looks well treated on his win on softish ground at Sandown last winter and, fit from the Flat, can make a successful return to hurdling under Sean Bowen. Support for Dan Skelton French recruit Lyssenko would make him a potential big threat. Scottish Champion winner Dedicated Hero may prove best of the remainder. ALL IN YOU (FR) LYSSENKO (FR) DEDICATED HERO (IRE)

races.title: BetMGM 'Future Stars' Silver Bowl 'Chasing Excellence' Novices' Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Runner-up in a Grade 1 novice hurdle, KLIMT MADRIK has the physique to make at least as good a chaser and showed promise when runner-up at Worcester on his reappearance. He can build on that effort to go one better, though Royal Infantry made a winning chasing debut at Hexham and isn't taken lightly for the Skeltons. KLIMT MADRIK (FR) ROYAL INFANTRY (IRE) INTOSOMETHINGGOOD

races.title: BetMGM Haldon Gold Cup Handicap Chase (Grade 2) (Limited Handicap) (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Successful in a Grade 1 novice here in April, MIRABAD made an encouraging return over hurdles when second in a listed race at Carlisle and he could still have more to offer as a chaser. He gets the vote ahead of JPR One , who showed that he retains all of his enthusiasm when defying top weight in a Cheltenham handicap on his reappearance, with Brookie also considered. MIRABAD (FR) JPR ONE (IRE) BROOKIE (IRE)

races.title: BetMGM Handicap Chase (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)
races.verdict: HERE COMES GEORGIE proved another fine advert for the sublime training skills of Dan Skelton at Cheltenham recently and can make light of a 7 lb rise for that strong-travelling success. Anthony Honeyball has an excellent recent record in this (when usually at Wincanton) and his Leave of Absence could prove the chief threat and the pick of his quartet. Montregard , Kap Vert and Konfusion all have plenty to recommend them too. HERE COMES GEORGIE LEAVE OF ABSENCE (FR) MONTREGARD (FR)
